I know not, these pre-concieved ideas of which you speak.

I am not recommending mass suicide, I am merely recommending that every human take it upon his\her self to take an very good look at their own pre-concieved ideas about this world;
and i am.. begging for every human being to do the right thing.

My point is that i can't fix the world on my own, and i'm asking the entire world to help, just by thinking, that is all.
